import os, sys, tempfile, unittest, importlib.util, pathlib, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
TREE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "stage2_RQ-VAE/TIGER_c117_global_sinkhorn_poincare"
sys.path.insert(0, str(TREE))
def _worker(rank, world, init_file, queue):
    import torch.nn as nn
    dist.init_process_group("gloo", init_method="file://"+init_file, rank=rank, world_size=world)
    torch.manual_seed(100 + rank)
    model=nn.Linear(3,2,bias=True)
    with torch.no_grad():
        model.weight.fill_(0.25); model.bias.fill_(0.1)
    ddp=nn.parallel.DistributedDataParallel(model)
    x=torch.tensor([[float(rank+1), 2., -1.]])
    y=ddp(x).square().sum()
    y.backward()
    grad=torch.cat([p.grad.detach().flatten() for p in ddp.parameters()])
    before=torch.cat([p.detach().flatten() for p in ddp.parameters()]).clone()
    torch.optim.SGD(ddp.parameters(),lr=.05).step()
    after=torch.cat([p.detach().flatten() for p in ddp.parameters()]).clone()
    own=torch.cat([grad, after])
    gathered=[torch.empty_like(own) for _ in range(world)]
    dist.all_gather(gathered, own)
    # Every process compares the independently gathered rank records.
    queue.put((rank, [v.cpu().tolist() for v in gathered]))
    dist.destroy_process_group()
class DDPConsistency(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_two_real_ranks_gather_gradient_and_updated_parameters(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            init=os.path.join(td,"rendezvous")
            ctx=mp.get_context("spawn"); q=ctx.Queue()
            ps=[ctx.Process(target=_worker,args=(r,2,init,q)) for r in range(2)]
            for p in ps: p.start()
            results=[q.get(timeout=60) for _ in ps]
            for p in ps: p.join(60); self.assertEqual(p.exitcode,0)
            self.assertEqual({r for r,_ in results},{0,1})
            for _, gathered in results:
                self.assertEqual(len(gathered),2)
                torch.testing.assert_close(torch.tensor(gathered[0]),torch.tensor(gathered[1]),rtol=0,atol=1e-7)
            # Different rank-local inputs yield distinct local loss/grad before DDP reduction,
            # while DDP-reduced gradients and resulting parameters match on both ranks.
            self.assertNotEqual(results[0][1][0], results[0][1][1])

import os, sys, tempfile, unittest, pathlib, importlib.util
from unittest import mock
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, torch
TREE=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/"stage2_RQ-VAE/TIGER_c117_global_sinkhorn_poincare"
sys.path.insert(0,str(TREE))
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("candidate_trainer",TREE/"train_rqvae.py")
trainer=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); sys.modules[spec.name]=trainer; spec.loader.exec_module(trainer)
class RealTrainerEntrypoint(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_main_trains_saves_checkpoint_exports_sid_and_uses_transition_loss(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            td=pathlib.Path(td); emb=td/"emb.npy"; frame=td/"train.parquet"
            rng=np.random.default_rng(9); np.save(emb,rng.normal(size=(4,4)).astype("float32"))
            pd.DataFrame({"user":[0,1,2,3],"history":[[0],[1],[2],[3]],"target":[1,2,3,0]}).to_parquet(frame)
            ckpt=td/"model.pth"; sidpath=td/"sid.npy"
            observed=[]; original_forward=trainer.RQVAE.forward
            def capture(model,*args,**kwargs):
                result=original_forward(model,*args,**kwargs); observed.append(tuple(float(x.detach()) for x in result)); return result
            patches=[mock.patch.object(trainer,"EMBEDDING_FILE",emb),mock.patch.object(trainer,"TRAIN_FILE",frame),
              mock.patch.object(trainer,"CHECKPOINT",ckpt),mock.patch.object(trainer,"OUTPUT_SID",sidpath),
              mock.patch.object(trainer,"OUTPUT_JSON",td/"sid.json"),mock.patch.object(trainer,"METRICS_PATH",td/"metrics.jsonl"),
              mock.patch.object(trainer,"EPOCHS",1),mock.patch.object(trainer,"BATCH_SIZE_PER_RANK",4),
              mock.patch.object(trainer,"WARMUP_EPOCHS",0),mock.patch.object(trainer,"EVAL_INTERVAL",1),
              mock.patch.object(trainer,"HIDDEN_SIZES",(8,)),mock.patch.object(trainer,"CODEBOOK_SIZE",(2,2,2)),
              mock.patch.object(trainer,"CODEBOOK_NUM",3),mock.patch.object(trainer,"CODEBOOK_DIM",3),
              mock.patch.object(trainer,"NUM_WORKERS",0),mock.patch.object(trainer.RQVAE,"forward",capture)]
            try:
                for p in patches: p.start()
                trainer.main()
            finally:
                for p in reversed(patches): p.stop()
            self.assertTrue(ckpt.is_file()); saved=torch.load(ckpt,map_location="cpu",weights_only=False)
            self.assertEqual(saved["epoch"],1); self.assertEqual(saved["selection"],"final_epoch")
            self.assertTrue(saved["state_dict"])
            self.assertTrue(sidpath.is_file()); sid=np.load(sidpath)
            self.assertEqual(sid.shape,(4,4)); self.assertEqual(len(np.unique(sid,axis=0)),4)
            self.assertTrue(observed, "trainer never invoked actual model forward")
            # Actual forward returns rec, assignment, balance placeholder, and train-transition loss.
            self.assertTrue(any(len(v)==5 and np.isfinite(v).all() and v[4] > 0 for v in observed),observed)
            metrics=[__import__("json").loads(x) for x in (td/"metrics.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
            self.assertTrue(any(x.get("event")=="ckpt_saved" for x in metrics))
